node.statement: 2.1.5: The action I is constructed from R^(1)_{μν} and R^(1)}, both gauge-invariant at linear order (the linearised Riemann tensor is invariant under h_{μν}→h_{μν}+∂_μξ_ν+∂_νξ_μ). Therefore I expressed in Bardeen variables is gauge-independent. QED. [Ref: Gauge Invariance of Linearised Curvature]
